description_en: Invokes the GrantInstanceToVbr operation to grant authorization of a VPC-connected instance to a VBR instance for cross-account VBR uplink scenarios
description_zh: 调用GrantInstanceToVbr接口将跨账号创建VBR上连场景的VPC实例授权给VBR实例
kebab_example: aliyun vpc grant-instance-to-vbr --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-owner-uid 1210123456123456 --instance-id vpc-bp1lqhq93q8evjpky0000 --grant-type All --vbr-region-no cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GrantInstanceToVbr

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC-connected instance for which authorization is to be granted.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要授权的VPC实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the VBR instance to be authorized. This account must be different from the caller's account. You cannot specify the caller's own account ID. This operation is used for cross-account authorization
parameters.help_zh: 接受授权的VBR实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID。该账号必须与调用方账号不同，不能填写调用方自身账号ID；本接口用于跨账号授权
parameters.name: vbr_owner_uid

parameters.help_en: The list of VBR instances to be authorized
parameters.help_zh: 接受授权的VBR实例的列表信息
parameters.name: vbr_instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC-connected instance for which authorization is to be granted
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The scope of the VBR instances to be authorized. Valid values:

All: Grants authorization of the VPC-connected instance to all VBR instances in the specified region under the specified Alibaba Cloud account. In this case, the VbrInstanceIds parameter can be left empty.
Specify: Grants authorization of the VPC-connected instance to the specified VBR instances. In this case, the VbrInstanceIds parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
接受授权的VBR实例的范围。取值：

All：将VPC实例授权给指定地域和阿里云账号（主账号）下所有的VBR实例，此时VbrInstanceIds参数可以为空。
Specify：将VPC实例授权给指定VBR实例，此时VbrInstanceIds参数需要配置
parameters.name: grant_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the VBR instance to be authorized
parameters.help_zh: 接受授权的VBR实例所在的地域ID
parameters.name: vbr_region_no
